messages.subject: str of list (bug?)
parts:
Hello...

I have created a list and then call str:

> lst = list(1, 2, 3, 4)
> str(lst)

List of 4
 $ :"Unmatched positional arguments"

===
The same does not issue any error if instead of list I use "c" do

> vec = c(1, 2, 3, 4)
> str(vec)
num [1:4] 1 2 3 4



Thanks...


Rodrigo
